ONGOING STORYLINES:
- Copper surplus vs. scarcity (logged Oct 16): ICSG projects the global surplus to more than triple by 2027. Copper fell for a third day on US inflation and easing Chile strike risk. Anglo American's CEO says tech giants are circling amid copper scarcity. Antofagasta shares fell on a flat 2027 copper outlook.
- Chile miner deaths (logged Oct 16): WSWS reports seven miners dead in three weeks. Source is partisan; figure unconfirmed.
- Gold M&A (logged Oct 16): Breakingviews says Gold Fields' $27bn play may stay in the M&A pit. Equinox's output rose 34% after its Orla merger.
- Hycroft (logged Oct 16): MINING.COM reports "bonanza" gold grades at its Nevada mine. No assay data or technical report yet.
- Lithium (logged Oct 16): PLS approved a $1.3bn Pilgangoora expansion. Pantera announced a US$2bn EnergyX lithium supply agreement.
- LM Baraga Basin (logged Oct 16): US Department of War is investing $5.22m in the project.
- Deep-sea mining order (logged Oct 16): Foley Hoag reviewed the legal landscape since the 2025 executive order. Legal status disputed (see views).

THE DESK'S EVOLVING VIEWS:
- Meldrum (Oct 16): Treats the copper surplus as near-term fact and scarcity as a longer bet visible in M&A. Reads Breakingviews as signalling more bidding rounds. Cannot confirm the deep-sea legal picture without the Foley Hoag piece. Disagrees with Yukon on copper timing and gold M&A.
- Yukon Cornelius (Oct 16): Says surplus forecasts describe refined metal while scarcity talk concerns concentrate, grades, and lead times, so both can hold. Calls the Breakingviews piece commentary, not a deal. Sees Equinox's output jump as acquired, not organic. Describes the deep-sea order as legally unsettled. Rates Pantera medium confidence.
- Dr I Simon (Oct 16): Sees copper's apparent contradiction as mostly a measurement problem. Flags US tariff policy as a live risk, with no COMEX or LME series in the material. Keeps unverified claims out of conclusions. Rates Pantera low confidence.
- Change of mind, Simon (Oct 16): Withdrew the lower-bond-yields explanation for gold. It is now a hypothesis pending a real-yield test.

OPEN PREDICTIONS:

- PREDICTION: The US government announces a formal change to copper import tariffs | BY: 2026-12-31 | CONFIDENCE: low (Meldrum; Dr I Simon) (made by Meldrum and Dr I Simon, Oct 16)
